snippet.title: Across the Obelisk: Necropolis of the Damned DLC Announcement
snippet.description:
🏰 Necropolis of the Damned — a major new DLC for Across the Obelisk — arrives December 2nd, 2025!

Descend into a gothic reimagining of Act 4, where witches stalk the Dusk Lands, vampires rule shattered halls, and the cursed kingdom of the Count awaits your party’s final judgment. Face new mechanics, new foes, and a brand-new ending that twists the fate of Obelisk forever.

🧛 What Awaits:
• A new alternate Act 4 + a fresh ending
• New mechanics: Infuse Aura, Leech Curse, and more
• 2 new heroes — Velarion (Blood Mage) & Nevermoor (Death Knight)
• 3 new maps packed with 45+ events and encounters
• New enemies: witches, wereravens, vampires
• New bosses across a 3-phase final showdown
• 20+ cards, 19 gear pieces, and new pets.

Enter the gates. Face the damned. Rewrite the end.
December 2nd. Be ready.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
